name: Shield Down Low
summary: Lowers the shield in your first-person view so it hides less of what is in front of you, while blocking too.
logoPrompt: A wooden shield with an iron rim tilted low at the bottom of the frame, with a small downward arrow beside it

cover.tagline: Your shield, out of the way.
bullets: Shield sits lower in first person

description: **Shield Down Low moves the shield further down in your first-person view, so you see more of the fight in front of you.**
- The held shield sits lower in either hand and covers less of the screen.
- When you block, it still comes up and turns towards the middle as usual, just from a lower spot, so you always know you are blocking.
- Banner patterns on your shield show as before.
- Only the first-person view changes: third person, the inventory, item frames and dropped shields look like vanilla.
Put the zip into the `resourcepacks` folder of your game, then turn it on under Options > Resource Packs.
- Resource pack for Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3. It only moves the shield in your own view, so blocking works exactly as in vanilla.
- Works on servers too; only you see the change.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or want it even lower? Leave a comment.
